description: The FireMonkey counterpart of vcl_26. A button whose caption grows by half again needs somewhere to put it, and there is empty form to its right. Widening is capped and rightward only, because a button keeps the place it was drawn in - it is positioned against the thing it acts on. Where there is no room to the right it falls back to growing taller and then to a smaller size, in that order. Drawn at FireMonkey's twelve point default the caption needs more room than the VCL twin's nine, so the width floor is met with more to spare rather than less.
